facts.topic: robot rotation WHY (0929 教训级铁律)
facts.fact: Re-uploading with the SAME robot REPLACES that robot's dev-version record. If the 体验版 (trial version) is pinned to that record, the pin gets bumped (钉位悬空) and all entries resolve against the released online version 1.0.7's old page table → QR scan shows 「页面不存在」. Hence: rotate robots 1..30 so a pinned record is never replaced by a subsequent upload, plus auto-run the trial health probe after every upload.

facts.topic: check_path=true semantics (0929晚 教训级修正)
facts.fact: check_path=true validates ONLY against the released-online-version (1.0.7) published page table. Evidence #19: with the trial pin healthy, the real page pages/ask/ask still returns 41030. So check_path=true can NEVER be a pin-health oracle — the old pre-issue 'hard gate' was permanently false-negative and was scrapped.

facts.topic: pin status has no API oracle
facts.fact: wxa/getversion returns 40066 (第三方专属 — third-party-exclusive), so the API layer cannot read the trial pin state at all. True pin verification = user scans the explicit-page QR on a phone (opens when pin healthy) + engine radar check (new traffic in the answers table).

facts.topic: trial health probe design (channel check only)
facts.fact: trial_health_probe.py is a 通道体检 probe (directly runnable AND importable via run()). It probes two pages with POST /wxa/getwxacodeunlimit, body {"page": <page>, "scene": "probe", "check_path": True, "env_version": "trial", "width": 280}, timeout=60: RELEASE_PAGE='pages/my/my' (exists in released 1.0.7 table, 神谕实测) and OUR_PAGE='pages/ask/ask' (not in old table → 41030 expected constant). Image detection: b[:3]==\xff\xd8\xff or b[:4]==\x89PNG; error text = first 120 bytes decoded utf-8/replace. Verdict: 'CHANNEL_OK' if RELEASE_PAGE returns an image, else 'CHANNEL_DOWN'. If OUR_PAGE unexpectedly returns an image it prints '异常:ask竟在老表?'. Summary line format: 'SUMMARY: <verdict> — 钉位无API判据；真判据=手机扫显式page码+引擎雷达新流量'.

The original probe's semantics were inverted (原版语义反了，废): it treated 'real page returns image = healthy / 41030 = pin dangling'. Victim damage listed: 出码硬闸误锁整个下午 (code-issue hard gate wrongly locked a whole afternoon), 监视哨假 BROKEN 误报（已删）(watchdog false-BROKEN alerts, deleted), and misleading post-upload probe output.

upload_qianwen.mjs still branches on line.includes('BROKEN') from the probe's SUMMARY, but the rewritten trial_health_probe.py only ever emits CHANNEL_OK or CHANNEL_DOWN — the BROKEN branch (and its '选为体验版' user-fix hint) can never fire from the current probe output. Stale wiring, not a runtime bug in the channel check itself.

localstorage-shim.cjs (388 bytes, verified on disk): miniprogram-ci's debug.js shouldRunInMainProcess probes localStorage.getItem; on Node 25 the corecompiler CHILD process crashes because a parent-process defineProperty cannot reach the child. NODE_OPTIONS=--require injects the shim into BOTH parent and child. Shim body: try { Object.defineProperty(globalThis, 'localStorage', { get: () => ({ getItem: () => null, setItem: () => {}, removeItem: () => {} }), configurable: true }) } catch {}

gotchas.symptom: miniprogram-ci upload on Node 25: corecompiler child process crashes on localStorage.getItem — and worse, can exit 0 as 假成功 (fake success), so a missing receipt is not the only failure mode; success itself can be silent garbage
gotchas.root_cause: miniprogram-ci debug.js shouldRunInMainProcess probes localStorage.getItem; Node 25 lacks it in the spawned corecompiler child process, and a defineProperty patch in the parent process cannot shadow anything in the child
gotchas.fix: Always invoke with NODE_OPTIONS="--require E:/AI-Station/WeAppForge/work/localstorage-shim.cjs" — the CJS shim defines a stub globalThis.localStorage (getItem→null, setItem/removeItem no-ops) and --require injects it into parent AND child processes

gotchas.symptom: QR scan of the trial code shows 「页面不存在」— recurring after uploads even though pages exist in the uploaded version
gotchas.root_cause: Re-upload with the same robot number REPLACES that robot's dev-version record; if the 体验版 pin points at that record it is bumped (钉位悬空), and every entry then resolves against the released online 1.0.7 old page table where the new pages don't exist
gotchas.fix: Rotate robots 1..30 via work/robot_cursor.txt ((last % 30) + 1, persisted + logged to work/robot_registry.jsonl) so a pinned record is never replaced; after upload, if pin dangles, the only fix is the user's manual step: 版本管理 → 该开发版本 → 「选为体验版」 (no API can do it)

gotchas.symptom: ENOENT / wrong-robot anomalies when running the uploader from any directory other than E:/AI-Station/WeAppForge
gotchas.root_cause: All paths are relative: projectPath 'projects/zongbao-ai', CURSOR 'work/robot_cursor.txt', registry 'work/robot_registry.jsonl', probe 'python work/trial_health_probe.py'. From a wrong cwd, the cursor read ENOENT is silently swallowed by the bare try/catch (falls back to last=1 → robot=2, silently re-burning early robots), while projectPath/writeFileSync/appendFileSync/probe-invocation paths hard-fail with ENOENT
gotchas.fix: Always cd to E:/AI-Station/WeAppForge first — the usage line's 'node work/upload_qianwen.mjs' already encodes this; treat the swallowed-cursor-read fallback as a known blind spot

gotchas.symptom: Post-upload 'TRIAL_HEALTH_PROBE_ERROR' printed after an otherwise successful upload (e.g. ModuleNotFoundError: curl_cffi, or probe script not found)
gotchas.root_cause: The .mjs invokes the probe with bare 'python' (no venv pinning, no -I) — it only works if that interpreter has curl_cffi installed; wrong cwd also makes the relative probe path unresolvable
gotchas.fix: Non-blocking by design: the error is caught, logged with message truncated to 200 chars as TRIAL_HEALTH_PROBE_ERROR(不影响上传), and upload success stands; to get the probe output, ensure bare python has curl_cffi and rerun from WeAppForge root (PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 is already set by the caller for Windows console encoding)

gotchas.symptom: Using /wxa/getwxacodeunlimit with check_path=true as a pre-issue health gate: real trial pages (pages/ask/ask) always return 41030 → gate permanently locked (误锁整个下午), watchdog emitted false BROKEN alerts
gotchas.root_cause: check_path=true validates ONLY against the released-online (1.0.7) published page table — trial-only pages fail validation regardless of pin health (evidence #19); pin state itself is unreadable because wxa/getversion returns 40066 (third-party-exclusive)
gotchas.fix: Never gate on check_path. Issue codes with the page baked in + check_path=false (new-path resolution, immune to the old table); the probe was rewritten to channel-check only (pages/my/my in old table = CHANNEL_OK oracle); true pin verification = user phone scan of the explicit-page code + engine radar (new answers-table traffic)

gotchas.symptom: upload_qianwen.mjs never prints the '>>> 需用户一步…选为体验版' hint even when the trial pin is dangling
gotchas.root_cause: The .mjs gates the hint on the probe SUMMARY containing 'BROKEN', but the 0929晚-rewritten probe only emits CHANNEL_OK/CHANNEL_DOWN — the BROKEN branch is dead wiring left over from the deleted false-BROKEN watchdog
gotchas.fix: Treat the hint as vestigial: rely on the documented real pin verification (phone scan + engine radar) and the manual re-pin step when a scan shows 页面不存在

gotchas.symptom: WeChat API calls from these scripts fail with TLS/WAF-style errors if sent with plain requests/curl
gotchas.root_cause: All HTTP calls deliberately use curl_cffi requests with impersonate='chrome' — the WeChat API surface rejects non-browser TLS fingerprints (project-wide TLS-fingerprint lesson applied here)
gotchas.fix: Keep impersonate='chrome' on every call (token GET timeout=30, post_json timeout=40, QR generation timeout=60); do not swap in plain requests

recipes.name: 永不404体验码 (trial QR immune to released-page table) + desktop scheme link
recipes.steps: 1) Parse E:/AI-Station/data/secrets/zongbao_qianwen_mp.secret (key=value lines → appid, appsecret). 2) GET https://api.weixin.qq.com/cgi-bin/token?grant_type=client_credential&appid=<appid>&secret=<appsecret> with curl_cffi impersonate='chrome', timeout=30 → access_token. 3) (Optional, desktop open) POST /wxa/generatescheme?access_token=<at> body {"jump_wxa":{"env_version":"trial"}}. 4) POST /wxa/getwxacodeunlimit?access_token=<at> body {"page":"pages/ask/ask","scene":"v042","check_path":false,"env_version":"trial","width":430} timeout=60 — the two load-bearing fields are explicit page + check_path:false (new-path resolution, immune to the online 1.0.7 old page table). 5) Sniff response: b[:4]==\x89PNG → png, b[:3]==\xff\xd8\xff → jpg, else print QR_FAIL + first 200 bytes. 6) On image, save to E:/AI-Station/WeAppForge/work/qr_trial_042.<kind> and log 'QR_OK <path> <bytes> <kind>'. 7) Verify delivery by phone scan + engine radar (answers-table new traffic) — never by any check_path=true gate.

recipes.name: Trial channel health probe (channel-only check, no pin oracle)
recipes.steps: 1) Token from the same secret via /cgi-bin/token (impersonate='chrome'). 2) Probe A: POST /wxa/getwxacodeunlimit body {"page":"pages/my/my","scene":"probe","check_path":true,"env_version":"trial","width":280} — pages/my/my genuinely exists in the released 1.0.7 table (神谕实测), so image response = API channel alive. 3) Probe B: same call with page='pages/ask/ask' — expect 41030 as a constant (page not in the released table; says NOTHING about the trial pin). 4) Verdict: RELEASE_PAGE image → CHANNEL_OK, else CHANNEL_DOWN; printed as 'SUMMARY: <verdict> — 钉位无API判据…'. 5) If probe B returns an image, flag '异常:ask竟在老表?'. Runnable standalone or importable (run() returns the verdict string).

recipes.name: Trial pinning (体验版) flow after upload
recipes.steps: 1) Upload lands as a dev-version record owned by robot N (rotation guarantees N's record is never overwritten by later uploads while pinned). 2) Pinning is USER-ONLY, no API exists (无API可代办): MP console → 版本管理 → the uploaded 开发版本 → 「选为体验版」. 3) Pin health cannot be read via API (wxa/getversion=40066 third-party-exclusive; check_path=true only sees the released table). 4) Real pin verification: user scans a QR whose code carries the page explicitly (check_path=false) — opens if the pin is healthy; corroborate with engine radar (new rows in the answers table). 5) Symptom of a dangling pin after a same-robot overwrite: scans show 「页面不存在」; fix = re-pin via step 2.
